entries.title: Psalms 69:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim. Of David.> Be my saviour, O God; because the waters have come in, even to my neck.

entries.title: Psalms 69:2
segments: My feet are deep in the soft earth, where there is no support; I have come into deep waters, the waves are flowing over me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:3
segments: I am tired with my crying; my throat is burning: my eyes are wasted with waiting for my God.

entries.title: Psalms 69:4
segments: Those who have hate for me without cause are greater in number than the hairs of my head; those who are against me, falsely desiring my destruction, are very strong; I gave back what I had not taken away.

entries.title: Psalms 69:5
segments: O God, you see how foolish I am; and my wrongdoing is clear to you.

entries.title: Psalms 69:6
segments: Let not those who have hope in you be put to shame because of me, O Lord God of armies: let not those who are waiting for you be made low because of me, O God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 69:7
segments: I have been wounded with sharp words because of you; my face has been covered with shame.

entries.title: Psalms 69:8
segments: I have become strange to my brothers, and like a man from a far country to my mother's children.

entries.title: Psalms 69:9
segments: I am on fire with passion for your house; and the hard things which are said about you have come on me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:10
segments: My bitter weeping, and my going without food, were turned to my shame.

entries.title: Psalms 69:11
segments: When I put on the clothing of grief, they said evil of me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:12
segments: I am a cause of wonder to those in authority; a song to those who are given to strong drink.

entries.title: Psalms 69:13
segments: ¶But as for me, let my prayer be made to you, O Lord, at a time when you are pleased; O God, give me an answer in your great mercy, for your salvation is certain.

entries.title: Psalms 69:14
segments: Take me from the grip of the sticky earth, so that I may not go down into it; let me be lifted up from the deep waters.

entries.title: Psalms 69:15
segments: Let me not be covered by the flowing waters; let not the deep waters go over my head, and let me not be shut up in the underworld.

entries.title: Psalms 69:16
segments: Give an answer to my words, O Lord; for your mercy is good: be turned to me, because of your great pity.

entries.title: Psalms 69:17
segments: Let not your face be covered from your servant, for I am in trouble; quickly give me an answer.

entries.title: Psalms 69:18
segments: Come near to my soul, for its salvation: be my saviour, because of those who are against me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:19
segments: You have seen my shame, how I was laughed at and made low; my haters are all before you.

entries.title: Psalms 69:20
segments: My heart is broken by bitter words, I am full of grief; I made a search for some to have pity on me, but there was no one; I had no comforter.

entries.title: Psalms 69:21
segments: They gave me poison for my food; and bitter wine for my drink.

entries.title: Psalms 69:22
segments: ¶Let their table before them be for their destruction; let their feasts become a net to take them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:23
segments: Let their eyes be blind so that they may not see; let their bodies for ever be shaking.

entries.title: Psalms 69:24
segments: Let your curse come on them; let the heat of your wrath overtake them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:25
segments: Give their houses to destruction, and let there be no one in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 69:26
segments: Because they are cruel to him against whom your hand is turned; they make bitter the grief of him who is wounded by you.

entries.title: Psalms 69:27
segments: Let their punishment be increased; let them not come into your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 69:28
segments: Let their names be taken from the book of the living, let them not be numbered with the upright.

entries.title: Psalms 69:29
segments: But I am poor and full of sorrow; let me be lifted up by your salvation, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 69:30
segments: ¶I will give praise to the name of God with a song; I will give glory to him for what he has done.

entries.title: Psalms 69:31
segments: This will be more pleasing to the Lord than an ox, or a young ox of full growth.

entries.title: Psalms 69:32
segments: The poor will see it and be glad: you who are lovers of God, let your hearts have life.

entries.title: Psalms 69:33
segments: For the ears of the Lord are open to the poor, and he takes thought for his prisoners.

entries.title: Psalms 69:34
segments: Let the heavens and the earth give praise to him, the seas, and everything moving in them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:35
segments: For God will be the saviour of Zion, and the builder of the towns of Judah; so that it may be their resting-place and heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 69:36
segments: The seed of his servants will have their part in it, and there the lovers of his name will have rest.
